The cart-service Service selector uses `app: cart-service`, but the new cart-service 4.2 pods use labels `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service` and others. The Service cannot find matching pods [cite: concepts/services-networking/service#defining-a-service-1]. Storefront logs show "connection refused" errors, and cart-service logs show zero requests (confirming pods receive no traffic).

Fix: Update the Service selector from `app: cart-service` to `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service` to match the new Helm chart labels.
